Got a bit of land and no idea where to start? Just tell this app what you have.
Start with your land. Mine's forty by twenty-five.
Your weather. Your sun. Fifteen minutes a day.
Add what you have, or dream of.
It suggests plants that suit your place, right now.
Then it draws your farm, to scale.
Your shopping list. Your first week.
It feels like a game. Except the food is real.
Tomorrow, we plant the first seeds. Part two.
